title: Gumshoe - Rain, Smoke and a Walking Bass - Noir Detective Jazz Game Music Pack - 44 Tracks
tagline: 44 track noir detective score: seventh chords on every chord, a walking bass, real swing in the club. MIDI + OGG.
description:
Gumshoe is a 44 track noir detective music pack for games: 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues, 51:43 of music, as OGG files with sample accurate loop tags plus all 44 editable MIDI sources. RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop points with no plugin, and the Readme gives the import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Royalty free for commercial games. Three full tracks are free to download on this page, with their MIDI.

One case in one rainy city, from the client at the door to case closed, with the club where the band never stops. The case: Gumshoe, A Client at the Door, The Office After Hours, The Case File, Reading the Scene, The Precinct, The Interrogation Room, Good Cop, Bad Cop, The Morgue and The Newsroom. The street: Rain on the Boulevard, Neon on Wet Pavement, The Stakeout, Tailing the Sedan, The Chase on Foot, The Alley Behind the Club, The Docks at Midnight, The Warehouse and The Last Train Out. The club: The House Band, Torch Song, After Hours Jam, The Piano Bar, The Casino Floor and A Drink Alone. The money: The Dame in Red, The Penthouse, The Mansion on the Hill and The Hotel Lobby. The trouble: The Boss of the Waterfront, The Shootout, Standoff on the Roof, The Double Cross, The Reveal and The Confession. Night and the end: Three in the Morning, The City Sleeps and Case Closed. Cues: A New Lead, Case Cracked, Dead End, A Body in the River, Nightcap and Shots Fired.

Seventh chords, every one. All 366 chords the tracks declare are four note seventh chords, not one plain triad: 125 minor sevenths, 117 dominant sevenths, 68 major sevenths, 7 half diminished, and 49 minor chords with a major seventh on top, the chord the 15 harmonic minor tracks rest on. 14 of them are tritone substitutes, a dominant seventh a semitone above the tonic that slides down into it. Checked in the shipped MIDI: all four tones of every chord under the accompaniment actually sound, 328 of 328; the other 38 are the openings of the full pieces, where the lead plays the theme alone.

A walking bass. On 22 tracks the bass plays a note on every beat: 552 of 552 bars carry four, and every downbeat is a tone of the chord, the root on 480 of them and the fifth on the other 72. On the last beat before the root changes it plays a note a semitone away from the next root and steps onto it: 160 approach notes across 160 root changes, counted in the MIDI. Open a walking track and read the part named bass.

Real swing in the club. The House Band, Torch Song, After Hours Jam, The Piano Bar, The Casino Floor, The Newsroom and A Drink Alone swing at 2:1: the second eighth of each beat lands two thirds of the way through it. 1,274 swung off beats and 0 notes off that grid, measured. Those 7 add a ride cymbal and a pedal hi hat on 2 and 4 in the second half of the loop, on MIDI channel 10. Every other track is straight.

One theme, every track. The seed theme, Gumshoe, reaches up a fourth and sinks back past where it started, and all 44 tracks state it in its own shape, counted by the harness in the finished MIDI. Four more themes come from it: Alibi is the seed turned over, for the crime scene and the double cross; Smoke is the torch song; Tail climbs three steps for following someone; Rimshot is the house band's riff, and it swings on the club numbers. 2,409 statements and fragments of the 5 themes across the album.

What is in it. 38 full pieces and 6 short cues, 51:43 of music, 15 in harmonic minor, 11 in aeolian, 10 in dorian and 8 in ionian, 34 keys, 54 to 176 BPM, all in 4/4. 31 General MIDI instruments, with alto, tenor or baritone saxophone on 11 tracks. Every pitched note is in its track's mode, in a chord the track declares, or a walking bass approach note: 17,115 notes read, none outside those three.

What you get. 44 OGG files, 38 of them with sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags, which is what RPG Maker MV and MZ read; each looping file ends exactly at its loop end. 44 editable .mid sources. A Readme with per engine import notes, the proof reports, and a royalty free commercial licence.

Gate results. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, and the reports ship inside the download. They say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks are for.

Three full tracks are free on this page, with their MIDI: Tailing the Sedan, a harmonic minor pursuit over the walking bass, The House Band, the swing number with the ride cymbal, and The Boss of the Waterfront, the boss.

An honest note. The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont, so the saxophones, piano, bass and drums are the General MIDI sounds of those names; load the MIDI into your own instruments to replace them. No jazz standard, film cue or song is quoted; every tune was composed for this record. The city and its case are invented. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used anywhere.

devlog.title: Gumshoe is out: a 44 track noir score with a walking bass and real swing
devlog.body:
Gumshoe is a 44 track noir detective score for games: one case in one rainy city, from the client at the door to case closed, with the precinct, the stakeout, the chase, the docks, the penthouse, a jazz club where the band never stops, a boss and a shootout, and the cues a game fires all day. It is live now, with three full tracks free to download from the page.

The idea. Every one of the 366 chords on the record is a four note seventh chord, 22 tracks carry a walking bass (160 chromatic approach notes, each landing on the next root), and the 7 club numbers swing at 2:1 with a ride cymbal and hi hat. Each of those is counted in the shipped MIDI, and the seed theme is stated in its own shape in all 44 tracks.

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. The loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks (Tailing the Sedan, The House Band and The Boss of the Waterfront) are for.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render; load the MIDI into your own instruments to replace the sounds. No jazz standard or film cue is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.
